More than 1,400 UC professors have called for the return of standardized testing requirements for incoming students. 

"There's always been this tension on college campuses over this between professors, who are teaching the kids, and administrators on campus, who have more PR concerns—making sure the catalogue looks right and there's enough diversity...

...vs professors who know you're not doing these kids any good by admitting them to schools where they can't handle the work."
